2424387.steps: 1.Configure LDAP in the firewall. 2.Create an user in AD server and configure a email address for the user in the server itself but don't enable OTP. 3.Import the user in the firewall, configure OTP via mail with a different mail address. 4.Login to the network with the user LDAP user imported in the firewall.
2424387.initial: User should receive the OTP for the email address configured in the firewall, not to the email configured in the AD server.
2424387.title: User should receive the OTP for the email address that is configured in the firewall, Not on AD server
